items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: He was playing then like Jimmy Smith, you know.

ctx.x: Well, they had King Kolax there. They had the Platters. That was the Platters' first job. And some group out of Canada. I can't remember the name of it. And they had an organist whose name was Jackie. Jackie Davis I think was his name. He was playing then like Jimmy Smith, you know.
